axes.concept: One public plan reference organised as a spatial consultation sheet; comparison selection is local, reversible and unrelated to account assignment.
axes.layout: A 180px plan index beside one rounded sheet of four horizontal plan rows; each row pairs identity/price with its full tool list. The extra selection view uses a two-by-two set of full plan options.
axes.navigation: Preserved Pictures/Sempertex header, horizontal comparison/selection navigation, plan-name anchor index, existing sign-in/account links and explicit return to full comparison.
axes.typography: Existing embedded Geist Sans: 24px page title and prices, 20px plan names, 14px tools, 12px availability/monthly metadata; tabular prices. No new family or display treatment.
axes.density: One shared comparison surface with 28px row insets and 24px tool spacing; full lists rather than disclosures. Tablet retains a 200px identity column and one tool column; phone stacks each row.
axes.components: Real installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input and Skeleton, production ring-and-dot mark, native language selector, details-based account disclosure and native radio selection inside rounded sibling panels.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures light/dark semantic tokens, including acento/sobre-acento for primary controls and selection; neutral section navigation and readable texto-suave availability labels. No palette changes.
axes.motion: Alternating horizontal row registration, vertically settling selection panels, a short selected-summary arrival and reversible hover/press response. Expressive 520ms/65ms stagger, 180ms controls; profile and reduced/still parity.
